commits.message:
feat: add agent resume, conversation source tracking, and auto-handover

- `agent resume`: full briefing with last handover, git state, session
  timeline, interleaved user+assistant conversations, memory files, and
  AGENTS.md key sections inlined
- Auto-handover: `agent handover` (no flags) auto-generates from
  conversation logs — zero effort, picks Claude Code, Cosine, or Aider
- Conversation source detection for Claude Code (~/.claude/projects/),
  Cosine (~/.cosine/sessions.json), and Aider (.aider.chat.history.md)
- New `## Conversation Sources` section in AGENTS.md template with
  timestamped pointers updated on init and handover
- Fix pipefail crashes when no JSONL files match glob patterns

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat: add agent mcp, test suite, recommend, setup, and cmux commands

- Add `agent mcp` as thin wrapper around mcp2cli for calling MCP servers
- Add `agent recommend` for logging workflow recommendations
- Add `agent setup` for checking/installing global tools (cmux, playwright-cli, mcp2cli)
- Add cmux integration helpers (status, progress, notify, browse, context, focus)
- Add playwright-cli integration for browser testing
- Add test harness (test.sh + tests/) with core and hook test suites
- Update README with expanded feature list and install instructions

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(agent): Add learnings/gotchas to agent handover

Introduce a new field for learnings and gotchas in the agent handover process. This includes updates to both interactive and non-interactive flows, allowing users to specify learnings via a new `-l` or `--learnings` flag. The handover markdown and `AGENTS.md` file are updated to include this information, providing crucial guidance for subsequent agents. Documentation in `README.md` has been updated to reflect these changes.

docs: fix install URL, add hooks docs, self-document agent commands in AGENTS.md template

- Fix install URL to point to actual repo
- Add Git hooks section (pre-commit reminder, post-commit logging)
- AGENTS.md template now includes agent command reference at the bottom
  so any agent reading it immediately knows how to use the handoff system
- Add agent version to install verification step

feat: add agent onboard command for unknown agent tools

New command: agent onboard <name> [config-path]
Registers any new agent tool by creating its config file pointing
to AGENTS.md. Auto-generates path as .{name}/instructions.md if
not specified. Appends to .agents/config.yaml for tracking.

initial: agent CLI — git for agents

Single bash script, zero dependencies. Creates AGENTS.md as the universal
handoff document, pointer files for 9 agent tools (Cursor, Windsurf, Cline,
Copilot, Claude Code, Cosine, OpenCode, Codex, Aider), git hooks for
handover reminders, and a structured handover log system.

Commands: init, handover, status, log, reinit
